decisions.reason: As a core yogurt line extension in the firm’s established organic Demeter range that remained listed through 2024, it likely has acceptable traction and low enough carrying cost to keep.
Because this 2024 cheese launch is close to existing capabilities and channels, management would usually preserve the option for another year while market acceptance is still being learned.

This recent sliced cheese variant also fits the core business, but its overlap with other cheese SKUs in a broad portfolio makes pruning somewhat more plausible even though the firm would still likely keep it for now.
